1. 确认 ETS 已安装，程序会自动查找常见安装位置和 Windows 安装记: 1. Make sure ETS is installed. The app checks common locations and Windows install records.

3. 使用“初始化并打开 ETS”创建快捷方式、启动后台监听并打开 ETS。以后: 3. Use Initialize and open ETS to create shortcuts, start the listener and open ETS. It then waits in the background.

启用后连接 10086 的 DevTools 网络域。每次检测到答题提交完成，会: Connects to the 10086 DevTools network domain. After a submission is detected, it waits 3 seconds and appends recent packets to the capture file, which is included in log exports.

个人凭据优先；未填写时只有启用体验模式才会调用公用 TTS Worker，每设备: Personal credentials take priority. Without them, the public TTS Worker is used only when Experience Mode is enabled, with limits of 10 requests per device and 30 per IP per day.
可一次导入 DeepSeek 和阿里云 TTS 凭据。保存时使用 Windows: Import DeepSeek and Alibaba Cloud TTS credentials together. They are encrypted with Windows DPAPI.
